text: You are pitch-matching everyday expenses to show the value of a TV package. For a customer who wants 200+ channels (including Sky Atlantic), a broadband boost to Gig1, and Netflix included, which daily expense is this compared to?

text: An existing O2 mobile customer wants to bring their broadband over to Virgin Media. They are currently looking at the standalone Solus M250 package for £25.99/month. To practice 'dialing up the value', which upgrade path should you lead with?
options: Step them down to the Solus Volt 350 for £22.99 a month
Lead with the Solus Volt Gig1 (boosted from M500) for £27.99 a month—a massive speed jump for just 46p more per week
Offer them the standard Solus M500 package without Netflix for £27.99 a month

correct: Lead with the Solus Volt Gig1 (boosted from M500) for £27.99 a month—a massive speed jump for just 46p more per week
